crossRefs.note: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.
You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding…
Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in its height…
The porch that was in front, its length, according to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one…

parallels.note: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

translations.web: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.
translations.bsb: Overlay it with pure gold both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
translations.asv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
